notes.title: 【Song of Death】Major update patched!
notes.content:
The [Song of Death] major update is officially live! After awakening, all characters can now not only change their illustrations and models but also gain brand-new passive talents. This update also introduces the Endless Mode and the Accessory Disabling Feature, offering you more ways to enjoy the game. Check out the detailed patch notes below!

Wishing you the best of luck on the battlefield!

Version 1.2.3 Update Notes
Main Updates:
Accessory Disabling List Added:
1.You can now disable specific accessories from appearing in battles through the accessory compendium. Only accessories that have been unlocked in the compendium can be disabled.

2.Awakened Characters:
Awakened characters come with a completely different skill set compared to their normal versions, offering even more powerful abilities.

3.New Endless Mode:
Endless Mode can be unlocked through the Stargazing Board. In this mode, battles will continue indefinitely and become increasingly challenging. Bosses will appear randomly in Endless Mode.

Minor Updates:
1. Fixed an issue where repeatedly giving up could cause enemy health to drop to 1.
2. Fixed an issue where the bond description box would sometimes not disappear.
3. Fixed overlapping fonts in the settings menu.
4. Fixed the incorrect effect of the Spring Onion accessory.
5. Fixed a text overflow issue in certain non-Chinese languages.
6. Fixed untranslated text appearing in the slashing screen effect when exiting to the main menu after a battle.
7. After exiting to the main menu post-battle, the game will now automatically select the character you last used.
8. Feel free to dive into the new features and enhancements. Good luck and enjoy the game! 😊

notes.title: [Patch Note] Bug fixes
【Song of Death】Original Sound Tracks launched!
notes.content:
This Original Soundtrack (OST) contains the complete score from "Song of Death."

The soundtrack for "Song of Death" was passionately crafted by the 一罐盐 Studio, using music to illustrate Ma Chao and his companions' journey as they battle through challenges to avenge his father. The main menu theme captures the heaviness and stillness before embarking on a journey with no return. Three scene themes respectively portray the anxiety of setting off, the abandon in the heat of battle, and the despair of being trapped deep within enemy lines. Meanwhile, the bonus levels are linked to the previous game, "Song of Wuxia," allowing fans of the series to relive the emotions from those past battles.

notes.title: 【重大更新】新角色！新关卡！新饰品！大的要来了！
notes.content:
Hello dear players! It has been a month since the release of "Song of Death" and our first incremental update is ready.

What have we updated first?
Previously, there was only black stockings in the game, which led to some feedback from players. So, the first thing we've done in this update is to introduce a new character type: a loli character with white stocking.

[b]New Character: [/b]
Zhang Qiying / Zhang Qiying [Awakened]

Passive Skill: Every 3 hits with a weapon increase its base damage by 1, lasting for 6 seconds. (This effect can trigger at most once every 0.1 seconds.)

[b]New Level: Hanzhong[/b]
New Bosses: Zhang Jiao / Yu Ji / Zuo Ci / Zhang Lu
This update also includes a new map and new bosses, offering a fresh experience with new scenery and dialogue.


[b]Damage Statistics[/b]
As mentioned by Lao Ju, damage statistics are in the works to help you evaluate top-performing weapons.

[b]Revamped Accessories[/b]
We've made significant changes to many old accessories that players were unhappy with, revamping some playstyles. For example, the dodge build, previously considered a joke, has been enhanced. With just one accessory, you can now achieve a dodge rate of around 100%, and with accessories that deal counterattack damage upon dodging, you can create a truly idle playstyle!

Modified Accessories:

Imperial Seal: Damage to Bosses +30% -> Damage to Bosses +50%.
Husky: Counterattack damage +25 -> Counterattack damage +60. Blocking reduces counterattack damage by 10, stackable, lasting 3 seconds.
Orange Cat: Defense +5 -> When taking damage, defense +3, stackable, lasting 6 seconds.
Kagemi: Dodge rate +25% -> When taking damage, dodge rate +10%, stackable, lasting 6 seconds.
Finger Guard: Attack speed -20%. On crit, stamina +1 -> On crit, stamina +1.
Blue Rose: Weapon damage +500% when only one weapon is equipped -> Weapon damage +100% and weapon attack speed +200% when only one weapon is equipped.
Spider Lily: All blocks count as counterattacks if equipped weapons are of different types -> All blocks count as counterattacks.
Wilderness Charm: Crit rate for talisman-type weapons +50%, crit rate for other weapons -20% -> Crit damage for talisman-type weapons +100%, crit damage for other weapons -40%.
Plume Feather: Successful dodges cause counterattack damage. Blocking or counterattacking doesn’t trigger counterattack damage -> Successful dodges cause counterattack damage.
Army Order: Effect range reduced by 80%. Weapons that hit without penetration or chaining have a 10% chance to instantly cool down -> Weapons that hit without penetration or chaining have a 10% chance to instantly cool down.
Kickball: Weapon cannot penetrate and can only attack once. When a weapon chains, it has a 10% chance to instantly cool down -> Weapon cannot penetrate. When a weapon chains, it has a 10% chance to instantly cool down.
ZitherZither: Weapon cannot chain and can only attack once. When a weapon penetrates, it has a 10% chance to instantly cool down -> Weapon cannot chain. When a weapon penetrates, it has a 10% chance to instantly cool down.
Moonlit Beauty: 50% chance to instantly cool down a random weapon when a block fails -> 50% chance to instantly cool down a random weapon when taking damage.
Hetian Jade Pendant: Counterattack damage -100%, counterattacks increase weapon damage by 50% for 6 seconds -> Counterattack damage -100%, counterattacks instantly cool down a random weapon in the equipment slot.
Hidden Contraption: When all weapons in the equipment slot are of the same type, dodge rate +25% -> Dodge rate +80%. Successful dodges reduce dodge rate by 20% for 3 seconds.
Second Salamander: When all weapons in the equipment slot are of different types, damage reduction +25% -> Each weapon type in the equipment slot increases damage reduction by 10%.
Spring Onion: When all weapons in the equipment slot are of different rarities, crit damage +100% -> Each weapon rarity in the equipment slot increases crit damage by 50%.
Golden Apple: Stamina recovery per round -8, block stamina recovery +2 -> Stamina recovery +2 on counterattack or block.
Dog Muzzle: Vitality recovery per round -4, block vitality recovery +1 -> Vitality recovery +2 on counterattack or block.
Ham Hock: Stamina recovery per round +10, stamina recovery -1 on attack -> Attack speed of utensil-type weapons +60%.
Curious Coin: Consumes 20% of current vitality per round, each point of vitality increases effect range by 1% -> Effect range +50%, losing 5 stamina reduces effect range by 3%.

[b]New Accessories[/b]
We've also introduced some new accessories, so feel free to explore their effects in the game!

We have more ideas, such as an endless mode, which we want to make endlessly replayable and engaging with more possibilities. Of course, more new accessories will be added to enrich the playstyles! However, these features might require more effort in future versions. We will continue to update, so stay tuned!

notes.title: PUBLIC TEST REALM is added!
notes.content:
Greetings to all of you!

In our previous announcement, we mentioned that we would be updating the following content soon:

1.1 Luo Tian Da Jiao:

1. New hero: Zhang Qiying, along with her awakening skin.
2. New map: Hanzhong.
3. Four new bosses.
4. Several new accessories.
5. At the same time, we will be making changes and optimizations to some of the old accessories that 6. players didn't like.

The good news is that we have completed this portion of the update, and we welcome you to experience it early on the public test branch!

To access the test branch, right-click on Song of Death, select properties, find the beta tab, and choice Playtest build to join the test.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to post them in this discussion thread.

Thank you for your continuous support! We will release the official update as soon as possible!

notes.title: [Song of Death] launched with a 10% discount!!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that [Song of Death] is now officially released!

This new game seamlessly combines elements of vampire survivor like, auto battler, and rhythm clicker genres. In [Song of Death], you can enjoy the following experiences:

[h3][list]
[*] Follow the beat of the BGM, feel the adrenaline rush from the resounding counterattacks!
[*] Create powerful builds with unique hero traits, support generals, weapons, bonds, and accessories, giving you unparalleled power! Dominate the battlefield like a true warrior!
[*] Play as Ma Chao, infiltrate Cao Ying's camp, avenge your father, and uncover the complex relationships between the main characters and numerous adversaries!
[/list][/h3]

[b]The game is launched with a 10% discount[/b], priced at only 6.291 USD$. If you own the previous game[b] [Song of Wuxia] [/b]or[b] [Noobs want to live] [/b]by LightningGames, you can enjoy an additional 10% discount through the bundle! This discount lasts for 14 days, so if you're interested in our game, don't miss out!

Let's meet in [Song of Death]. See you there!

notes.title: Delay anouncement
notes.content:
Dear players,

After the demo release during the Next Fest, we have received a lot of feedback! We want to extend our sincerest thanks to everyone.

Through our interactions and communication, we have noticed that some aspects of the game's design, difficulty curve, and weapon effects may not provide the best experience and need further refinement and optimization.

After much discussion, we have made the difficult decision to delay the release date by about a month. The exact release date will be announced later.

During this month, we will focus on the following developments:

Improving controller compatibility
Enhancing localization adaptations
Adding settlement and unlock prompts
Optimizing weapon balance
Adjusting the difficulty curve of levels
Optimizing the default key layout
Adding key remapping functionality
We will do our utmost to perfect "Song of Death" and present the best possible version to everyone! Please wait a little longer (deep bow).

Thank you again for your support and encouragement during this time.
